summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-cypress@9.0.4 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, when no local `bun` binary is present, downloads Bun v1.3.13 from the oven-sh GitHub release, extracts and chmods the binary in a temp directory, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled CJS blob with a `@bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-mangled identifiers, and an array-rotation string decoder (`WV8StW`) over a ~1000-entry constants table. The payload is not referenced by the package's `main`, is not enumerated in the package's `files`, and its purpose is undocumented. The preinstall hook fires automatically on `npm install`, so the obfuscated blob is executed via a freshly-fetched alternate runtime that bypasses Node-level tooling. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: an opaque, obfuscated blob shipped in the tarball is executed under a runtime the package installs at install time, on every consumer who installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
